def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # The full-width marker divides the background from the movable shape.
    line=next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0] != 0 and row[0] != 4)
    marker=g[line][0]
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,marker)]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs)
    dr=(line+1-r0) if r0>line else (line-1-r1)
    color=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in cells: g[r+dr][c]=color
    if dr>0:
        stripe=r0+dr-1
    else:
        stripe=r1+dr+1
    if 0<=stripe<h: g[stripe]=[8]*w
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    marker_col=next(c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1)
    marker=g[0][marker_col]
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,marker)]
    color=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    # Move object horizontally to immediately beside the divider, on its right side.
    dc=marker_col+1-c0
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c+dc]=color
    stripe=c1+dc+1
    if stripe<w:
        for r in range(h): g[r][stripe]=8
    return g
